label: dialog-content/root
classes: fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 flex w-[calc(100%-2rem)] max-h-[640px] max-w-(--container-md) -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex-col gap-6 overflow-hidden rounded-(--radius-4xl) border border-border-subtle bg-popover p-6 text-sm text-popover-foreground outline-none backdrop-blur-xl

label: dropdown-menu-content/box
classes: z-50 flex max-h-(--available-height) w-(--anchor-width) min-w-32 flex-col overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto rounded-(--radius-3xl) border border-[color:var(--border-subtle,var(--border))] bg-popover p-2 text-popover-foreground backdrop-blur-xl outline-none
note: The popup's own box — fill, stroke, radius, inset. Its itemSpacing separates a single Items slot and describes nothing visible, so the element's gap is audited against that slot below.

label: dropdown-menu-content/items
note: The same element as dropdown-menu-content/box. Figma splits the popup into the frame and an Items slot; the gap between menu items lives on the slot (4px), which is what gap-1 renders.
